mapper.insert: INSERT INTO members ( member_id, member_pwd, member_name, nickname, email, profile ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{memberPwd}, #{memberName}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{profile} )
mapper.select: SELECT member_id, member_pwd, member_name, nickname, email, profile, create_at, DATE_FORMAT(create_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS create_at_str FROM members WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
